description: Stock fundamentals by ticker (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA): revenue, gross, operating and net income, EPS, margins, revenue and earnings growth, ROE, cash, debt, equity, free cash flow, dividends and buybacks for the last fiscal years or quarters, from the company's SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings. Use to screen a stock, value a company or compare two businesses. Example: ticker=AAPL. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (instead of ticker)

ticker.description: Stock ticker or company name, e.g. AAPL (or give cik)

name: stock_fundamentals
title: Stock fundamentals: financials by ticker
